title: US markets and the Federal Reserve Board closed — Washington's Birthday (the Monday AFTER February expiration, not inside expiration week)
source: NEWS: THREE INDEPENDENT LEGS, all re-fetched and re-parsed by this event's initial research on 2026-09-09 rather than inherited from the proposal. (1) nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched direct (HTTP 200 after its 302, 109,180 bytes) — the page states 'All NYSE markets observe U.S. holidays as listed below for 2026, 2027, and 2028'; its cells, parsed one by one against the 2026/2027/2028 year headers, read "Washington's Birthday | Monday, February 16 | Monday, February 15 | Monday, February 21". Its FULL footnote list was read rather than the row alone — the four markers are '*' (no New Year's holiday in 2028, the Saturday case), '**' (early close Monday 2028-07-03), '***' (early close the day after Thanksgiving, incl. Friday 2028-11-24) and '****' (early close Thursday 2026-12-24). NONE attaches to February in any year, so no adjacent equity session shortens. (2) federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/k8.htm, fetched direct (HTTP 200, 82,205 bytes, stamp 'Last Update: July 8, 2026') — its table gives "Washington's Birthday | February 16 | February 15 | February 21 | February 19 | February 18" across the 2026-2030 columns, UNASTERISKED, so both the Reserve Banks and the Board of Governors are closed (the page's '*' marker means 'Saturday — Banks open, Board closed' and lists only 2026-07-03, 2027-06-18, 2027-12-24, 2027-12-31 and 2028-11-10). (3) Reproduced by statute and weekday arithmetic independent of both: 5 U.S.C. 6103 fixes Washington's Birthday on the THIRD MONDAY in February, and the third Monday of February 2028 is 2028-02-21 (2028-02-01 is a Tuesday). Filed estimate on the same taxonomy grounds the sibling closure entries presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15, good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26, memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31 and labor-day-market-closure-2026-09-07 all documented, not on date doubt: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an exchange's or the Board's own holiday calendar, and this lane does not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-09), which read the one prior proposal first — proposals/presidents-day-market-closure-2028-02-21.from-fomc-minutes-2028-02-16.json — per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md's 'when your own event was proposed by others' rule. That proposal now stands shadowed and inert. NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED: a full closure trades nothing by definition, symbols is empty, and a re-grep of docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md for holiday/closure keying returns ZERO hits in both, run 2026-09-09. THE STRUCTURAL FACT THAT MAKES 2028 DIFFERENT FROM ITS 2027 SIBLING: February 2028's third Friday is 2028-02-18 and its third Monday is 2028-02-21, so the closure falls the Monday AFTER expiration week rather than inside it. That breaks the 2025-2027 run the presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15 ledger measured, and it matters empirically — measured on SPY/^VIX daily bars 2010-01-01 -> 2026-09-08 (cache busted), Monday-holiday weekends whose Friday WAS a monthly expiration (n=21, the 2028 shape) show VIX higher on reopen 57% of the time against 77% (49/64) for holiday weekends whose Friday was not, and 56% (422/755) for all ordinary weekends — a two-proportion z of 0.11 against that ordinary baseline, i.e. indistinguishable. The same suppression appears at large n on ordinary weekends (47%, 82/174 after an expiration Friday vs 59%, 340/581 otherwise; z = -2.66). Read the sibling's long-weekend caution as SUBSET-SPECIFIC, not as a property of this date. CORRIDOR IS ONE-SIDED: everything within +/-5 days sits BEFORE the closure — fomc-minutes-2028-02-16 (D-5, canonical, estimate), vix-expiration-2028-02-16 (D-5, proposal, estimate) and opex-2028-02-18 (D-3, proposal, estimate) — so unlike 2027 the Tuesday reopen 2028-02-22 currently carries no competing dated explanation. Second-order: the closure compresses the week of 2028-02-21 to four sessions (Tue 02-22 -> Fri 02-26); expiration week itself is a full five. The fixed-income side is UNSOURCED — SIFMA's holiday-schedule page, fetched 2026-09-09, publishes US panels only through 2027 (its furthest 2028 entry is the 2027 schedule's tail, 'New Year's Day 2027/2028: Saturday, January 1, 2028'), so 2027's 'full bond close, no flanking early close' finding is NOT carried forward here. Proposed and filed as an estimate; an estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
